section_summary: Page 38 is a publication colophon. Pages 39–69 begin the August 1946 issue of the Bank of Japan’s Financial Statistics Monthly, with tables on banking, credit, insurance, postal savings, securities, prices, and government bonds. Many tables compare monthly figures from 1944 through June 1946.

subfiles.title: Publication colophon
subfiles.about: Printing and publication details for a Bank of Japan statistical publication.
subfiles.summary: Lists printing and publication dates, Tokyo addresses, and names associated with printing and publication.

subfiles.title: Financial Statistics Monthly, No. 5, August 1946
subfiles.about: Monthly statistics on Japan’s banking system, financial institutions, securities, prices, and public debt.
subfiles.summary: The issue opens with contents and a chart of banknote circulation, bank deposits, and bank loans. Its tables report assets and liabilities of the Bank of Japan, banks, trust companies, insurers, credit cooperatives, and public financial institutions, along with postal savings. Later pages cover stock exchange activity, bill clearing in Tokyo and Osaka, Tokyo price indexes, and national government bond issues and balances.
